summary: Logo presentation section displaying brand logos as grid or slider.
shortDescription: The Logo Presentation section displays partner, brand, or certification logos in either a static grid or animated slider format. Logos can be arranged in one or two rows with configurable alignment. Each logo item supports a title, optional link, uploaded image, and individual background color override. The slider mode includes navigation controls and optional scrollbar. Commonly used to showcase partnerships, media mentions, certifications, or payment providers.
